test.create_query: CREATE TABLE window_functions_sliding (i UInt32, v UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY i
CREATE TABLE window_functions_sliding_big (i UInt32, d Date, v UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY i
CREATE TABLE window_functions_sliding_parts (i UInt32, p UInt16, d Date, v UInt32) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY tuple()
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO window_functions_sliding SELECT number, (number * 7919) % 100000 FROM numbers_mt(1500000)
INSERT INTO window_functions_sliding_big SELECT number, toDate('2020-01-01') + intDiv(number, 15000), (number * 7919) % 100000 FROM numbers_mt(15000000)
INSERT INTO window_functions_sliding_parts SELECT number, number % 7, toDate('2020-01-01') + intDiv(number, 60000), (number * 7919) % 100000 FROM numbers_mt(60000000)
test.query: SELECT medianExact(v) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM window_functions_sliding FORMAT Null
SELECT quantile(0.5)(v) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM window_functions_sliding WHERE i < 800000 FORMAT Null
SELECT quantilesExact(0.25, 0.5, 0.75)(v) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM window_functions_sliding WHERE i < 1000000 FORMAT Null
SELECT topK(3)(v % 1000) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 50 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM window_functions_sliding WHERE i < 500000 FORMAT Null
SELECT uniqExact(v % 1000) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 100 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM window_functions_sliding WHERE i < 800000 FORMAT Null
SELECT count() OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 200 PRECEDING AND 200 FOLLOWING) FROM window_functions_sliding_big FORMAT Null
SELECT sum(v) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1000 PRECEDING AND 1000 FOLLOWING) FROM window_functions_sliding_big WHERE i < 5000000 FORMAT Null
SELECT max(v) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1000 PRECEDING AND 1000 FOLLOWING) FROM window_functions_sliding_big WHERE i < 6000000 FORMAT Null
SELECT avg(v) OVER (ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1000 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM window_functions_sliding_big WHERE i < 6000000 FORMAT Null

SELECT sum(v) OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY i ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) FROM window_functions_sliding_parts FORMAT Null
SELECT count() OVER (ORDER BY d RANGE BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) FROM window_functions_sliding_big FORMAT Null
